title: NouSR kit options: Castorice (1407)
description: A scenario member's kit_options for Castorice (docs/proposals/scenario-kit-options.md, DESIGN.md K25). Every option has a finite domain, so an optimizer can enumerate it from this file.

netherwing_finish_turn.description: The Netherwing turn (its own, counted from the summoning) on which it launches Breath down into the finisher. 1 = burn, as the game's auto-battle and Fribbels' combo do. 2 or 3 = hold: on earlier turns Netherwing launches Breath only while its HP is above 25%, and uses Claw Splits the Veil on a turn that starts at 25% or less.
